cases.sentence: Боже, Ты ___ мой, Тебя я ищу.
cases.translation: God, you are my God, I seek you.
cases.explain: The predicate uses the nominative case after the verb быть (to be).

cases.sentence: плоть моя по ___ томится в краю сухом.
cases.translation: My flesh longs for you in a dry land.
cases.explain: The preposition по (to/for) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: I have seen you in the sanctuary.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Your loving kindness is better than life.
cases.explain: In comparison, the genitive case is used after 'better' (лучше).

cases.translation: And I will lift up my hands in your name.
cases.explain: The possessive adjective takes the accusative form.

cases.translation: When I remember you on my bed.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: и в тени твоих ___ я возрадуюсь.
cases.translation: And in the shadow of your wings I rejoice.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition в in this context.

cases.sentence: Те, кто жаждут ___ моей, сойдут в нижний мир.
cases.translation: Those who seek my life will go down to the depths.
cases.explain: The transitive verb жаждут (crave) governs the accusative case.

reading.ru: Боже, Ты Бог мой, Тебя я ищу, душа моя жаждет Тебя, плоть моя по Тебе томится в краю сухом и бесплодном, где нет воды.
reading.question: Where is the Psalmist and what does he experience?
options: In a dry, barren land where there is no water, thirsting for God
reading.correct: In a dry, barren land where there is no water, thirsting for God
reading.explain: The verse places him in a dry, waterless land, expressing spiritual and physical thirst.

reading.ru: Я смотрел на Тебя в святилище и видел силу Твою и славу, уста мои будут славить Тебя, потому что Твоя милость лучше жизни.
reading.question: What did the Psalmist see in the sanctuary and why will he praise God?
options: God's power and glory; because His mercy is better than life
reading.correct: God's power and glory; because His mercy is better than life
reading.explain: He has seen God's power and glory in the sanctuary, which compels him to praise God.

reading.ru: Словно лучшими яствами душа моя насыщается, и уста тебя славит радостно, когда вспоминаю тебя на ложе своем и думаю в часы ночные о тебе.
reading.question: When does the Psalmist's soul find satisfaction and joy?
options: When remembering God on his bed during the night hours
reading.correct: When remembering God on his bed during the night hours
reading.explain: The Psalmist finds joy in meditating on God during the night on his bed.

reading.ru: потому что ты моя помощь, и в тени твоих крыльев я возрадуюсь.
reading.question: Where does the Psalmist find refuge and joy?
options: In the shadow of God's wings
reading.correct: In the shadow of God's wings
reading.explain: God is his help, and he finds joy under the protective shadow of God's wings.

reading.ru: Те, кто жаждут души моей, сойдут в нижний мир, они падут от меча, став добычей шакалов.
reading.question: What fate awaits those who seek the Psalmist's life?
options: They will go to the depths, fall by the sword, and become prey to jackals
reading.correct: They will go to the depths, fall by the sword, and become prey to jackals
reading.explain: The text describes the judgment: descent to the depths, falling by the sword, and becoming prey.

reading.ru: Царь же возликует о Боге, и все, кто клянется именем Божьим, восхвалят его, а устал житцов умолкнут.
reading.question: Who will praise God at the end according to this verse?
options: The king and all who swear by God's name
reading.correct: The king and all who swear by God's name
reading.explain: The king will boast in God, and all who swear by His name will praise Him.
